claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a case but no ownership history or wear is visible.
No legible brand, model, or platform text; witness identity is by_type only.
No words in photo 0 are legible enough to identify a title.
Whether a disc is inside the case is not shown; photo 0 shows no disc.

risks.risk: The case may be empty with no game disc inside.
risks.proof: A photo or clip showing the case opened with the disc present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an empty case with no disc.

risks.risk: The disc may be scratched, cracked, or warped.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or clip of the disc surface.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a damaged or unreadable disc.

risks.risk: The case may have cracks, broken hinges, or scuffs.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the case edges, hinges, and corners.

risks.risk: The game may not function and has not been tested.
risks.proof: A video clip of the game installing and running on a PS4 console.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untested and possibly non-functional.

risks.risk: The platform or region may not be PS4 or may not work in Abuja.
risks.proof: A photo of the spine or disc showing the platform and region code.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown platform or region compatibility.

risks.risk: Instruction booklets or extra inserts may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included booklets and inserts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as case only with no booklets.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the case spine and insert to read the title, platform, and region.
Photo of the case opened showing whether the disc is inside.
Close-up photo of the disc surface for scratches or cracks.
Close-up photos of the case hinges, edges, and corners.
Video of the game being installed and played on a PS4 console.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a video game case, so it can be priced at its worst case even though the seller's title, platform, and disc claims are unproven.
